title: weekly reliability roundup scratch
content:
Purpose: quick prep notes for Monday SRE ops sync. This is a scratchpad — keep short bullets, questions to raise, and clear follow-ups.

Topline summary:
- SLO health: platform request success SLO (99.9% monthly) currently at 99.83% for March -> ~0.07% burn of error budget remaining (~20% of month). Short-term trend: small daily regressions on 3/20-3/23 tied to model-puller timeouts.
- Paging: total pages last week = 28 (P1=1, P2=6, P3=21). P2s down ~30% vs previous week; P3 chatter up due to noisy alerting on read-only DB lag.
- Top incident: 2026-03-22 model-puller spike causing 15m latency increase for hosted-api-r2; root cause: regressed circuit-breaker config in deployment redwood/model-service#789.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool utilization steady at 62% (gpu-util: 58% average), autoscaler detected one shortfall window on 3/24 (10m) — possible cold-starts from recent rollout.

Agenda items to run in the sync (20-30m):
1) Quick metrics snapshot (Micah) — 5m: SLO numbers, error budget, paging summary.
2) Incident review (Jon) — 7m: model-puller spike: RCA status, mitigation, permanent fix ETA.
3) Alert hygiene (Asha) — 5m: noisy DB-lag alert adjustments; proposed threshold changes and mute plan.
4) Rollout watchlist (Priya) — 5m: recent canary that touched model-service and autoscaler interaction; coordinate with release-eng.
5) Action items + owners — 3m: confirm owners and due dates.

Notes / talking points (scratchy):
- SLO nuance: current 99.83% is still within error budget but trend matters — show 7d rolling and per-route (hosted-api vs private endpoints). We should highlight that private deployments unaffected.
- Paging trend: reduce P3 noise by consolidating DB-lag multi-alerts into one composite alert (threshold + sustained window). Mention risk of suppressing signal; propose a short trial mute for non-business hours.
- Incident mitigation: temporary rollback of cb config restored baseline in ~6m; we pushed a hotfix that broadens timeout + adds backpressure metric. Need PR + test coverage before closing.
- Autoscaler cold-starts: possible relation to recent image change that increases startup on 80g models. Ask release-eng to run canary with reduced initial replicas to reproduce.

Questions to raise in sync:
- Is the model-puller metric (pull-time-ms) instrumented end-to-end? We are seeing client-side timeouts but unclear if it's upstream or network. Who owns the pull pipeline observability?
- For DB-lag alert consolidation, can data-platform own a short-lived composite alert so SRE can monitor without duplicating?
- Confirm SLA communication: do we need to notify any Dedicated customers about the brief 15m blip? Ops/CS input required.

Action items (explicit):
- Micah: prepare 7d and 30d SLO sparklines + per-route breakdown for sync (due: 2026-03-25 EOD).
- Jon: finalize RCA draft for 3/22 model-puller spike; include timeline, root cause, and hotfix PR link (SRE-412) (due: 2026-03-26).
- Asha: implement consolidated DB-lag alert proposal in staging and present thresholds; include a plan for 48h trial mute during maintenance window (due: 2026-03-27).
- Priya: coordinate with release-eng to run startup-time canary for image v1.14 on a dedicated pool mimic (due: 2026-03-28).
- CS/Eng Liaison (TBD): draft short customer note for Dedicated customers if incident is judged user-impacting (due: 2026-03-27).

Follow-ups / personal notes to self:
- Add per-route tokenization to SLO dashboard (hosted-api-r2 shows higher tail latency).
- Check alarm runbook for model-puller timeouts — update playbook to include network-level checks and how to force rollback.
- Remind oncall to annotate any mitigations in incident ticket before handoff.

Risks & open items:
- If model-puller regressions continue we risk more sustained SLO burn. Consider temporary autoscale policy tweak to favor lower cold-starts at peak hours.
- Alert consolidation must not hide early signals for real P1s — need a short kill-switch.

Quick links (for presentation):
- SLO dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/slo/platform-request-success
- Incident ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SRE-412
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-service/pull/789
- Oncall rota: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/rota

Misc scratch reminders (unpolished):
- TL;DR for execs: brief line on health + 1 pager if they ask.
- Bring up runbook gaps for private deployments separately (not part of this sync).

End of scratchpad. Will clean and move to shared drive if we need a polished agenda doc.
